instruction: Apply borders around all the data cells (A1 through E4). Use any border style. Save the file.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying borders to the data range A1:E4. Evaluator checks if cell C3 (sample cell in the middle) has borders after save.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires borders on all 20 cells (A1:E4), but evaluator only checks 1 cell (C3)
Sampling approach is insufficient: User could apply borders to only C3 or a subset of the range and still pass verification
Cannot fully verify instruction compliance: Instruction explicitly says 'all the data cells (A1 through E4)' but only 5% of cells are verified
Getter and metric logic are correct for what they check (detecting if any border exists on C3)
Postconfig properly saves the file before verification, ensuring file state is persisted
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Check multiple cells across the range: sample at least corner cells (A1, E1, A4, E4) and a middle cell (C3) to verify borders were applied to the entire range
Use a getter that can read border info for a range of cells (A1:E4) instead of a single cell
Add a metric that verifies all cells in the range have borders, not just one cell
Alternative: Simplify the instruction to 'Apply borders to cell C3' if only checking one cell is acceptable
